updates.title: Big catch-up update: court matters, Bill of Costs, redesigned documents & more
updates.notes: LegalBill Mobile now matches the desktop app. New since your version: court matters (High Court / Magistrate / Miscellaneous) with automatic firm references and a searchable South African court picker; a full Bill of Costs with taxation and Allocatur certificate; fee notes grouped by matter with matter-level payments and receipts; redesigned professional fee notes, receipts, quotes and statements; trust and VAT reporting improvements; a cleaner sign-in screen with the Canaan AI signature; and many stability and sync fixes. Your data is safe and continues to sync as before. Tap Install update to download the new app, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version.
